description: This file is an HTML document that sets up a Vue.js-based web app, defining multiple Vue components for a reading list application, including header, book input, book list, and button grid components, and mounting the app to a DOM element.

methods.name: addNewBook
methods.description: Adds a new book to the books array in the Vue app data when a new book is created via the input component.

methods.name: mountApp
methods.description: Initializes and mounts the Vue app to a specified DOM element, setting up the main template and data structure.

methods.name: mountNestedApp
methods.description: Mounts a nested instance of the Vue app within the main app's mount point as referenced.
